desc: MF-Q (ICML 2018) on URB. paper/BASELINES.md B4.
Host block == iql/config1.json, so the difference from URB's IQL is
exactly the mean-action input.
mf_hidden = 64, mf_embed = 32  the release's prob embedding branch
(Linear(K,64) -> ReLU -> Linear(64,32)), mfrl_pytorch algo/base.py.
field_scope = od  every traveller on the same OD pair, humans included.
Averaging one-hot action vectors is only meaningful where the action
index means the same road for everybody; see CHECKLIST_mfq.md item
FIELD-1. 'all' reproduces the release's group-wide mean.
exploration = epsilon  the host schedule. The paper's Boltzmann
temperature is in the units of ITS rewards, and URB pays -1000; set
exploration = boltzmann with a temperature on the scale of the Q
differences to run the paper's rule instead.
MEASURED PROPERTY OF URB'S SHIPPED NETWORKS, 2026-09-19: the median
origin-destination pair carries exactly ONE traveller on all seven of them
only 0.7-3.2% of travellers ever have an EARLIER same-OD peer -- except on
ingolstadt_custom, where it is 70%. So on saint_arnoult the observation's
four count coordinates are zero for 97% of travellers on every day of the
run. Three defaults below follow from that; see the checklist item named.
field_scope = all (NOT od): a same-OD 'mean field' would be one
traveller's own one-hot action. See CHECKLIST_mfq.md FIELD-1.
